title.narrative: Malawi - Transforming High-potential Resilient Value Chains (M-THRiVE)

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to increase firm growth and access to finance for targeted firms in Malawi's export value chains.

This project will support export firms and productive SMEs in Malawi to increase exports and stimulate job creation. Components include:Component 1. Strengthening value chains for exports: this component supports new exporters through an export readiness program to enhance Malawi's export capacity. Component 2. Financing exporters and productive SMEs: this component will provide financing and de-risking solutions, delivered via an apex institution and PFIs, to support exporters and suppliers. Component 3. Project management: this component will support PIU to implement the Project and will also undertake specific activities to support PIU and PFIs' capacity on E&S, M&E and relevant activities.
